blocks.x: Corporate learning and vocational systems are judged on capability transfer: skills taxonomy, personalized pathways, credential portability and employer verification. The systems that prove skill deltas win the budget conversation. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in skills taxonomy management, pathway personalization, assessment/verification, with credential issuance close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
What the operations floor feels every week
For Workforce & Vocational Training, the places value leaks:

items: HRIS, LMS and performance data siloed; skills picture guessed.
Training content one-size; engagement and transfer low.
Certificates unverifiable across employers; value lost.
Enrollment, compliance tracking and reporting manual.
B2B training ops costs opaque per client.
